name: After-Class Practice
desc: Jahoda's specialty. After seeking advice on baking techniques from Ineffa for the sixth time, Jahoda finally presented her assignment — a handmade pastry. The shape is a bit wobbly, but the sweet scent of berries is irresistible, and the taste... well, it can't be too bad, right?

value.text: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.
